title: What Is House Hacking?
description:
🏡💡 Ever heard of House Hacking?

It’s one of the smartest ways to build wealth through real estate — even with a small investment! 👏
Here’s how it works:
➡️ Buy a home as your primary residence
➡️ Put as little as 3% down
➡️ Live there for 1–2 years (2 years is ideal unless life happens 😉)
➡️ Then… you’re eligible to buy another one! 🙌

That’s what I did! I downsized to a smaller home with my daughter, and as my real estate biz grew, so did our needs — so I upgraded again! 📈

House hacking = living smart while investing in your future.
Are you ready to start?
